description:
🌿 About Papa Vince

Papa Vince isn't just another food brand — we're a Sicilian family keeping traditional, nutrient-rich foods alive in a world of ultra-processed products.

Our products are made in Italy, where food quality isn't a trend — it's a way of life. We use time-honored methods to preserve nutrients, flavor, and integrity at every step.

✨ What Makes Us Different?

🍝 Our Pasta

  • Our pastas are non-enriched — a rarity in the U.S. market, where most pasta has synthetic vitamins added back after processing strips them out.
  • Stone ground and never reconstructed, which preserves the original food matrix rather than breaking the grain down and rebuilding it.
  • A complex carbohydrate made from whole ingredients, the way pasta has been made in Sicily for generations.

🫒 Our Extra Virgin Olive Oil

  • We publish our lab results. Every harvest is tested by HPLC and the Certificate of Analysis is on our website — most brands never show you theirs.
  • Our current harvest measures 10.29 mg of hydroxytyrosol and tyrosol derivatives per 20 g. EU Regulation 432/2012 sets 5 mg per 20 g as the threshold for the authorised claim that olive oil polyphenols contribute to the protection of blood lipids from oxidative stress, with a daily intake of 20 g of olive oil. Ours measures roughly double that threshold.
  • Cold-pressed, unfiltered, and single-source — from our family's groves, not blended from anonymous bulk oil.

🌱 More Than Food

At Papa Vince, we don't just sell food — we share a way of eating that our family has kept alive for generations. Real ingredients, honest labels, and a table worth gathering around.

🤝 Who We're Looking For

We keep our affiliate program small and personal. We partner with people who genuinely cook, eat, and care about food quality — home cooks, recipe creators, wellness writers, and anyone whose audience trusts what they recommend. Audience size matters less to us than whether that trust is real.

Permitted: your own blog, newsletter, social channels, video content, community posts, and word of mouth.

Not permitted: paid search advertising of any kind, brand bidding, coupon and deal sites, cashback and loyalty platforms, browser extensions, pop-ups, and direct linking. Referrals from these sources are denied automatically.

A note on claims: please describe our products using the figures we publish. Don't attribute health outcomes, cures, or medical benefits to our food. If you want to cite our olive oil numbers, link to our Certificate of Analysis — it's the strongest thing you can show, and it's verifiable.
payout_period: Payouts are issued on the 6th of each month with a $50 minimum. Earnings under $50 will roll over and be added to the next month’s payment.

term_and_condition:
Before the clean version — your current terms contradict what you've been doing, in two places. Both need fixing or the new clauses won't hold.

Conflict 1 — Section 2 currently permits advertising. "Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers." That's an express permission to advertise. A paid-search ban bolted on elsewhere would contradict it, and the permission would likely win.

Conflict 2 — Section 6 promises exactly what you've been denying. "Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There's no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then)." Under your own terms, an affiliate who touches one of your existing customers is entitled to commission on their future orders. That's the clause the loyal-customer denials have been running against — $147.91 in July, $33.12 in August. You've been enforcing a rule your terms don't contain.

Papa Vince Affiliate Program — Terms and Conditions
Last updated: August 24, 2026

Welcome to Papa Vince! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant ("we" or "merchant") and an affiliate ("you" or "affiliate") who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else's referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you're not assigned a branded coupon, then you're not allowed to promote the coupon.

(REPLACED) Affiliate may promote the merchant website through their own social media channels, website, blog, newsletter, video content, or in person. Promotion through paid advertising of any kind is not permitted — see Section 7.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

(ADDED) Commissions are reviewed and approved manually before payment. A minimum balance of $25 in approved commission is required before a payment is issued; balances below this amount carry forward to the next payment period.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate's link or use the coupon.

(REPLACED) Within the cookie window, subsequent orders placed by a customer you originally introduced to Papa Vince will result in commission without that customer needing to click your link again. This applies only to customers you introduced. Commission is not earned on customers who were already buying from Papa Vince before your referral — as a guideline, a customer whose first Papa Vince order predates your referral by a year or more, and who orders regularly, is not considered introduced by you. Customer purchase history is checked against our store records during review.


7. Paid Search Advertising (NEW)

Affiliates may not promote Papa Vince through paid search advertising. This includes, without limitation, Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, and any other pay-per-click search advertising, whether or not the ad references Papa Vince by name.

This specifically prohibits bidding on "Papa Vince," variations, misspellings, and any Papa Vince product or trademark term; using Papa Vince names or trademarks in ad copy, display URLs, or ad extensions; and directing paid search traffic to papavince.com, whether directly or through a redirect.

We use automated detection for referrals originating from paid search. Any referral identified as originating from a paid search click will be denied and will not earn commission. Repeated violations will result in removal from the Program and forfeiture of any unpaid balance.

8. Attribution Integrity (NEW)

Commission is earned only on sales you genuinely originated. Referrals will be denied where the affiliate did not bring the customer to Papa Vince, including:

  • Referrals generated by browser extensions, coupon toolbars, cashback plug-ins, or any software that applies affiliate tracking at or near checkout for a customer who arrived by another route
  • Referrals on customers who reached papavince.com through organic search, direct navigation, email, or their own account page
  • Referrals on existing Papa Vince customers you did not introduce
  • Self-referrals, or purchases made by you, your household, or accounts you control

Each affiliate may hold one account. Operating multiple accounts, or directing commission to a payment address associated with another affiliate account, is grounds for removal from the Program and forfeiture of any unpaid balance.

We review every referral before approval and may deny any referral where the customer's recorded click path does not show the affiliate as the source.

9. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: vitina.feo@papavince.com.

(ADDED) We may remove an affiliate from the Program at any time for breach of these Terms.

10. Changes to these Terms (NEW)

We may update these Terms from time to time. Changes take effect on the date stated at the top of this document and apply to referrals created on or after that date. Continued participation after that date constitutes acceptance.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document. We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to vitina.feo@papavince.com for support.
